witch.name: Little Witch
witch.hello: [excited] Abraca-boo! I'm Little Witch, and my broom only flies backwards!
witch.trick: hopped on the magic broom, which only flies backwards, and zoomed back-first into the dark with a trail of sparkles
witch.trick_sfx: magical sparkle swoosh flying past, cartoon, playful
witch.party: did backwards loop-the-loops on the broom until everyone cheered

ghost.name: Friendly Ghost
ghost.hello: [giggles] Boo-hoo-hooray! I'm Friendly Ghost. Want to be friends?
ghost.trick: began to glow, brighter and brighter, like the cosiest nightlight in the world
ghost.trick_sfx: soft magical glow humming up, gentle bright chime at the end
ghost.party: played the silliest game of peekaboo anyone had ever seen

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin Kid
pumpkin.hello: [cheerfully] Gourd-geous! I'm Pumpkin Kid. My smile lights up the night!
pumpkin.trick: flashed a great big glowing grin that lit up the whole place like a lantern
pumpkin.trick_sfx: warm whoosh of a lantern lighting up, cheerful pop, cartoon
pumpkin.party: led a wiggly pumpkin conga line all the way round and back again

house.name: Haunted House
house.line: The windows glowed yellow, the floorboards went creak, and the cobwebs sparkled like silver.
house.arrive_sfx: spooky cartoon house ambience, wind outside, distant friendly owl hoot
house.noise_sfx: a slow creaky wooden door opening, cartoon style
house.culprit: a tiny mouse in a party hat, pushing the door open with a big pink cupcake
house.party_sfx: cartoon party horn toot and small crowd cheering, kids Halloween

patch.name: Moonlit Pumpkin Patch
patch.line: There were rows and rows of glowing pumpkins, all grinning in the moonlight.
patch.arrive_sfx: night crickets chirping in a field, gentle breeze, calm
patch.noise_sfx: leaves rustling then a soft cartoon thump of a pumpkin rolling
patch.culprit: a sleepy little hedgehog, rolling a baby pumpkin along like a ball
patch.party_sfx: cheerful cartoon party horn and a quick happy fiddle flourish

woods.name: Whispering Woods
woods.line: The twisty trees swayed and whispered, and fireflies blinked on and off like tiny stars.
woods.arrive_sfx: soft wind whistling through trees at night, leaves whispering
woods.noise_sfx: a spooky wind howl that turns into a funny wobbly owl hoot
woods.culprit: a little owl in a striped scarf, practising the loudest hoot in the woods
woods.party_sfx: cartoon party horn and fireflies twinkling chime, happy crowd

cat.name: Black Cat
cat.hello_sfx: a cute friendly cartoon cat meow
cat.scared: puffed up like a fuzzy black pom-pom, and every whisker went boing
cat.scared_sfx: startled cartoon cat yowl with a springy boing
cat.happy: purred so loudly it sounded like a tiny motorbike

bat.name: Bat
bat.hello_sfx: small bat wings flapping quickly with a cute tiny squeak
bat.scared: zipped behind {hero} and hung there upside down, with both eyes squeezed shut
bat.scared_sfx: fast nervous fluttering of small wings, tiny squeak, cartoon
bat.happy: did happy flips in the air

skeleton.name: Silly Skeleton
skeleton.hello_sfx: funny cartoon skeleton bones rattling like a xylophone
skeleton.scared: rattled so hard that a funny bone fell off and bounced away
skeleton.scared_sfx: cartoon bones rattling and clattering, one bone bouncing away boing
skeleton.happy: danced until every single bone jingled
